intro: A bowl of bubur nasi ikan has an estimated 280 kcal. Most of the calories come from the rice in the porridge, while the fish gives you protein.
diet: Definitely. Fish porridge is a light, protein-rich option for breakfast or dinner. But porridge digests quickly, so some people get hungry again fast. Add more protein or veggies to stay full longer.
tips: Ask for extra fish or add an egg to boost protein.
Go easy on the shallot oil and fried shallots on top.
Skip the cakoi, or share one with a friend.

swap.name: Fish porridge + egg, no cakoi
swap.why: More protein and stays with you longer, without the extra oil from cakoi.

faq.q: What fish is usually used in fish porridge?
faq.a: Usually ikan batang, ikan merah or ikan haruan. Some stalls use dory fillet.

faq.q: Is fish porridge good when you're unwell?
faq.a: Porridge is a common choice when appetite is low because it's soft and easy to swallow. If you have health issues, follow your doctor's advice.

faq.q: Can I make fish porridge quickly at home?
faq.a: Yes. Use leftover rice, cook it with water and ginger, then add the fish slices when it's almost done.
